title: Sentinel Shield release-status contract
description: Canonical, machine-readable release status (config/release-status.json): which version is current, whether it is actually PUBLISHED as a GitHub Release, which versions it supersedes, and which ref shipped consumer workflow templates must pin. scripts/validate-release-status.sh is the enforcing reader; every current-status document and active workflow template is checked against this file, so a release literal is maintained in exactly one place.

contract.description: Contract identifier; bumped only for a breaking shape change.

repository.description: owner/name of the repository that owns these releases.

current.description: The current stable release. `published: true` asserts a real GitHub Release exists and is verifiable.

superseded.description: Previously current releases of the same major line, newest first. No active status document may present any of these as latest.

prior_supported_line.description: Latest release of the prior still-supported major line (v1.x).

consumer_ref.description: The immutable Sentinel Shield ref shipped workflow templates must pin (SENTINEL_SHIELD_REF).

kind.description: A moving branch is never a valid consumer ref.

status_surfaces.description: Active documents that MUST state the current release. Each is required to exist and to mention the current tag.

historical_documents.description: Frozen documents (glob patterns) that record historical truth and are therefore exempt from the stale-latest sweep. They are never rewritten to the current version.

historical_trees.description: Directory prefixes whose contents are immutable evidence/fixtures and are exempt from the stale-latest sweep.

active_workflow_templates.description: Shipped consumer workflow templates/examples whose SENTINEL_SHIELD_REF must equal consumer_ref.value.

commit.description: Full 40-hex commit the tag targets. Short SHAs are rejected: they are ambiguous.

published.description: TRUE only when a GitHub Release exists for `tag`. A pushed Git tag alone is NOT publication.
